display_long_description:
**ENTER FREELAND - YOUR VR ADVENTURE AWAITS**

Freeland is a massive multiplayer VR MMORPG where you decide how you want to play. Explore vast planets, meet players from around the world, embark on quests, level up, discover epic gear, battle powerful bosses, and build your own adventure across a living virtual galaxy.

Create your own full-body AI avatar simply by describing what you want to look like. Forge friendships, join guilds, become the strongest, or create your own path through the universe.

● Explore vast open-world planets with unique environments, challenges and adventures.

● Complete quests, level up, discover gear, master weapons and magic, and grow stronger.

● Battle powerful bosses and enemies across the galaxy.

● Fly through space and travel between planets in your spaceship.

● Race cars and jet skis, or ride dragons, horses and other mounts.

● Challenge other players in PvP arenas and compete for the top of the leaderboards.

● Build your own planet for other players to explore.

● Create your own stories and quests and give your world its own adventure.

● Join guilds, team up with friends, and take on the galaxy together.

The galaxy is threatened by Ventax, the rogue architect whose corruption spreads across Freeland. Explore the worlds, uncover their stories, forge alliances, and shape your own destiny.

**Your character. Your world. Your adventure. Your Freeland.**
